title: Coforge, OFSS, Persistent Systems, Infosys, TCS, Wipro lead IT stocks rally, Nifty IT rises 4.5% over 30,000 mark - The HinduBusinessLine
summary: IT stocks surged, with the Nifty IT index climbing 4.5% due to strong buying across companies, despite some sectors like retail and automobile facing softness. Discussions with companies suggest stable demand and resilient trends, with some delays in client decision-making due to uncertainties around new AI tools.
sentiment_reason: The market is experiencing a negative sentiment due to near-term uncertainties and increased scrutiny in AI-linked deals, despite overall strong deal pipelines and attractive valuations.
